name: Chipotle Tomatillo Green-Chili Salsa
desc: Copycat Chipotle green salsa of roasted and raw tomatillos, jalapeno, cumin, cilantro, and citrus.

source.title: Chipotle Tomatillo Green-Chili Salsa (Copycat)
source.evidence: Same eleven ingredients in the same amounts, the same 500°F roast with some tomatillos held back raw, and the same food processor finish.

ingredients.raw: 2 lb tomatillos, husks removed, rinsed, and halved
1-2 jalapeño peppers, stemmed (seeded for less heat)
1/2 medium red onion, cut into large chunks
1/2 cup loosely packed fresh cilantro leaves
1 tsp kosher salt, plus more to taste

steps: Preheat the oven to 500°F and line a baking sheet with foil.
Set aside 4 tomatillo halves (about 2 whole tomatillos) raw. Arrange the rest, with the tomato, cut side down on the sheet. Roast until softened and lightly charred, about 20 minutes.

In a food processor, combine the roasted tomatillos and tomato, the reserved raw tomatillos, 1 jalapeño, the onion, garlic, cilantro, cumin, and oregano. Pulse until blended but still slightly chunky.
Stir in the lemon and lime juices, salt, and pepper. Taste, and add more jalapeño or its seeds for more heat. Serve chilled or at room temperature.
tips: The salsa tastes hotter while warm and on its own; the heat mellows once chilled and eaten with food.
